en: Why!? Why would you do that?
Why wouldn't I? I shouldn't be the one taking all the blame!
(Ugh. My writer's rep got hammered... Hope I can still get work after this!)
Seto-san... There's something I need to tell you.
Go ahead... Kurashina.
Please forgive me, Seto-san! I fell for a bribe from another team.
They promised to pay me until next year's draft, and that they would double the contract amount offered by the Wyverns.
That's why I... I can't join the Wyverns!
All right. That's what it was, after all.
I'm really sorry, Seto-san. If you could find it in your heart to forgive me...
It's all right, Kurashina. Thanks for being honest with me.
Seto-san...
The path you choose is up to you. Whichever team you sign with, your talent will make you a star.
I guarantee it. And believe me⑬I've been doing this job for a long time.
But make sure you keep training hard over the course of this next year. I'm looking forward to seeing you play once you're in the pros.
I know you can do it. You're not any ordinary rookie. Got it? Have confidence in yourself.
Why, though... Seto-san, why do you care so much about me?
Isn't it obvious? Because I see your potential. Have been ever since you were in middle school.
Some day soon, your pitching is going to pack stadiums and drive fans wild. I was the first to see that in you, before anyone else.
I don't care if it isn't with the Wyverns. As a lifelong fan of baseball, I looked forward to seeing you shine. I still do.
*sniffle*
So, you keep moving forward. I'll never stop being your fan.
Thanks for waiting, Tatsuo. Well, I promised you a drink, didn't I?
You sure you're all done here?
Yeah. Should be.
All right. Then I'll be happy to oblige.
Take care, Kurashina. Go home before your joints feel the cold. Taking good care of yourself is part of your job as a pro.
God, I must sound so stupid but... I was wrong. There's no way I can give up on the dream you shared with me.
I know I'm asking a lot after all I did, but...
May I join the Wyverns?
Kurashina, look⑬
I'm asking you! Please give me a second chance. I'll do anything to join... to make up for the trouble I caused.

Yes, I may be stupid and immature, but I know I can make
the Wyverns proud⑬that I'd be right for the team. Because
you're there to support me.
Well would you look at that. I've always known you were a fine judge of character, Seto-san.
Flattery'll get you nowhere with me, Tatsuo.

Don't I know it. Looks like I'll be taking a rain check on
that drink tonight. I assume you're gonna be busy.
Yeah, I have to get the official contract written up to sign this can't-miss rookie.
Really? You're... still gonna sign me?
Kurashina. I can only be this nice to you before you sign. Once you're ours, we'll kick your ass like any other rookie.
Yes, sir! And thank you! I promise not to let you down!
(Heh. Me, turning down a free night out? Never thought I'd see the day...)
Kurashina said it was his dream to join the Wyverns. How did it come to this?
(Kurashina took off toward Mid Square. I should go after him.)
Hey, Tatsuo. Did you change your mind about meeting the rookie? If you can go, I'll treat you to a drink after.
Oh, hey, excuse me. Are you... Tatsuo?
It's me, Seto! The scout? With the Wyverns?
Whoa! Is this really Seto-san I'm talking to? Man, the years have not been kind to you!
Boy, it's been what, over a dozen years and that's all you have to say? But it's good to see you after all this time.
Likewise! You still a scout?
Yeah. I'm on my way to see a rookie⑬the kid we picked first overall in the draft.
Oh, yeah, was that Kurashina? He was the star pitcher at Koshien this summer.
That's him. We got lucky in the draft lottery. Kurashina's a local boy, too, so we just need to hash out some details, and we'll get him signed.
You still haven't lost your hustle. That's great.
So, uh, what about you? Been hanging in there?
Oh, you know me. Actually, I'm a journalist now⑬I work for an adult magazine. You could even say I have a <Italic>large reputation</Italic> in the industry... Heheh. Heh.
Huh. Is that right? Well, guess someone's gotta write the words beside the pictures that no one ever reads. So that's what you've got yourself into.
You've had it tough, haven't you? Ever since that game.
I... think I'll be going now. It was good talking to you again. Oh, and you really shouldn't be seen with me, by the way.
Don't be stupid. Don't you worry about that.
Besides, I was just about to invite you to join me. Do you feel like meeting our star rookie? If you've got the time, that is.
Kurashina wanted to talk to me, so I'm off to see him. How about I treat you to a drink when we're done?
Hey, if it's on you, I'd sure appreciate it. But are you sure it's all right for me to tag along?
I wouldn't be inviting you if it wasn't. You don't need to be shy around Kurashina, either. We don't keep secrets from each other.
Don't tell me you're not curious about him. This Kurashina kid is the Wyverns' big hope.
I won't deny I'm curious...
Then it's decided. I assume you're coming?
No, I really shouldn't.
You're sure? It's really okay, you know.
Next time, maybe. See you.
That's an offer I can't turn down. I remember you used to take me out all the time back when I was on the farm.
You don't drink as much as you used to, I hope? You should be getting to that age when you learn a little restraint.

Aww, heck no. I can still knock 'em back like the good old
days. Besides, I still got some youth left in me. Mostly
below the belt...
There he is, Tatsuo. The kid in the school uniform⑬that's Kurashina.
Oh wow, that really is him.
Hello, Seto-san. Thanks for coming out to see me.
No problem. Until the contract's signed, you're an important negotiating partner. You're just another rookie after that, of course.
This fellow here, his name's Tatsuo Shinada, and...
Pardon me, Seto-san, but may I speak first?
Come again? Oh, right, you did say you wanted to discuss something.
Um, Seto-san, I'm sorry, but... I decided not to sign with the Wyverns after all.
What!? Wait a minute here. Why all of a sudden?
You said you were looking forward to becoming a Wyvern.
I feel terrible about letting the Wyverns down after they drafted me first, but I've made up my mind. I'm sorry, Seto-san.
But... What happened? Has some other team been talking to you?
Come on, tell me what this is all about.
Look, I'm sorry, Seto-san.
Your "sorry" doesn't even begin to suffice for an explanation.
Besides, what do you intend to do? Are you going to put your career on hold until next year's draft?
I can't answer that.
Oh, you can't?
I won't negotiate with the Wyverns anymore. I already decided. Now if you'll excuse me...
Kurashina...
What the hell just happened... Why'd he change his mind?
Sounds to me like somebody changed his mind for him.
I just don't understand. Kurashina's always wanted to join his home team.
He said it was his dream!
Guess that dream got bought and sold.
What are you going to do now, Seto-san?
I can't do a damn thing if this is how he's ending negotiations with the team. What can a lowly scout do?
I found Kurashina when he was still in middle school.
I knew at a glance that the kid had potential. We weren't allowed to contact him, but I kept an eye on his progress.
After the draft, I finally got to meet him in person. I told him I'd been keeping track of his playing career over the years.
I told him how his pitching was great in a certain game, and how unlucky he was in another. He was impressed by that.
Dang... So you guys have some history.

Yes, so how did it come to this? I simply cannot wrap my
head around it...
(Only Kurashina can explain that. He went off toward Mid Square... Maybe I should go after him.)
*pant* *pant* Forgive me! Please... I never meant for any of this to happen.
Save your breath. You need to apologize to Seto-san, not me.
I'm not going to rake you over the coals for accepting a bribe from a different club.
It's a choice that's literally life-changing. I don't know how much they offered you, but I can understand being blinded by the cash.
Or are you going to tell me everyone's doing these kinds of backdoor deals these days?
Even so, you still have obligations. You told Seto-san it was your dream to join the Wyverns, didn't you?
You have to live up to your words. At least come clean to Seto-san and apologize.
Seto-san was working hard to make your dream come true. I'd say you owe him that much.
I understand. If he can forgive me, I will.
Oh, Shinada-san, thank god. Did you manage to bring me some food?
Sorry, man. Hang on a bit longer. Think you can make it?
Yes... But please do hurry.

Sorry, dude. I haven't picked up anything yet. Hang on just
a little bit longer, okay?
I can't accept anything over 500 yen, or anything that's not a Nagoya specialty.
As the magazine's resident gourmet, I know the food around town. You can't fool me.
Are you a pain in the ass or what? Sheesh. All right then, I'll be right back.
You handed over a <Color:8>Miso Katsu Lunch Set<Color:Default>.
You handed over <Color:8>Tebasaki Chicken Wings<Color:Default>.
You handed over an <Color:8>Eel Bun<Color:Default>.
You handed over a <Color:8>Grilled Onigiri with Miso<Color:Default>.
You handed over a <Color:8>Juicy Tebasaki Senbei<Color:Default>.
Here. Will this do?
Oh, you're a lifesaver! Thank you!
Ahhh... This must be what it feels like to be revived from the dead.
Glad to hear it. I had to look high and low for something that fit your bill, you know.

I'm sure you did. And I was hungry enough to eat anything,
too, but you came through with what I'd hoped for. It was
the greatest meal ever!
This is another thing I was really saving for a rainy day, but since you were so helpful, please take it.
You got a <Color:8>High-grade Platinum<Color:Default>.
Glad to hear it. So, did it meet your expectations?
Yes. I was hungry enough to eat anything, but you came through with something quite satisfying.
This is another thing I was saving for a rainy day, but since you were so helpful, please take it.
You got a <Color:8>Rubber Ball<Color:Default>.
Well, I hate to sound ungrateful, but...
To be honest, I thought you could've tried a little harder. Y'know, being that I was dying of hunger and all.
But, yes, I was famished, so I was ready to accept anything. And I did.
You got some <Color:8>Lighter Oil<Color:Default>.
Listen, if you had some kind of trump card saved up for a rainy day, you should've used it long ago. You were, no joke, starving to death!
Well, you never know when something worse might happen! Sorry to put you out, though.
Man... Run your own errands next time.
You got 2,300 experience points.
Uh, excuse me? You all right there?
Ugh... I⑬ Wha? That you, Shinada-san?
Huh? Oh. I know you. Don't you work part-time at the editorial office? Himoji, right? Are you working on a story?
No... What story could I possibly be working on?
I'm starving, man... Can't move a muscle.
I only had energy drinks this week. I'm so weak I can't even stand... let alone speak.
Whoa. I know you get paid peanuts, but you had to know you'd end up this way if you didn't eat.
I know... I know. But, here I am.
You have to get something in you. Fine, wait here. I'll go get you some grub.
I think it's fate that brought you here, Shinada-san... May I make a request?
Yeah, what?
Just in case this happened... I kept this 500 yen coin... as my trump card.
You should've used that earlier.
I may be down... but my spirit is pure. My pride won't let me accept charity.
Then you're better off prideless, I'd say.
No... My pride is what carries me. When I was a child, and deep into poverty...
When... When the rich kids would keep the trading cards and throw away the chocolate... I never once picked it up and ate it.
To accept charity now... would be to betray my childhood self. I can't bring myself to do it.

Dang, you just had to go and inspire me. All right, if it
means that much to you, let's hear that favor.
Please... buy me the most expensive Nagoya specialty you can... with this 500 yen.
The more health it can restore... the better.
You got 500 yen.
Okay, so get as close to 500 yen as possible, and it has to be a Nagoya specialty. Oh, but the more health it restores, the better? How am I even supposed to gauge that?
